overlaps.conflict_summary: E8 defines risk tiers; B2R defines progressive capability levels. Treating B2R level 5 as risk tier 5 would incorrectly over-risk low-volume transparent validation messages.
overlaps.recommended_resolution: Keep E8 risk tiers canonical for action risk. Keep B2R as capability maturity taxonomy and map low-risk validation messaging to E8 Tier 2.

overlaps.conflict_summary: Preflight and router both gate external actions but router does not fully understand later capability domains.
overlaps.recommended_resolution: Upgrade action_authorization_router to call canonical risk tier mapping and capability-domain checks.

overlaps.conflict_summary: C2 introduced deterministic decision/control envelopes parallel to the older router.
overlaps.recommended_resolution: Make C2/E15D policy call the router or promote router vocabulary so one allow/deny source exists before real E16C.

overlaps.conflict_summary: B2R declares gateway contract; C2 turns it into execution modes.
overlaps.recommended_resolution: Fold both into a canonical gov-mcp execution contract proposal and promote to gov-mcp.

overlaps.conflict_summary: Readiness fixtures, owner-reported feedback, and actual customer responses can be confused if schemas remain parallel.
overlaps.recommended_resolution: Use E12/E14 feedback event schema as canonical validation feedback and mark C2/C3/E15A fixtures as pre-feedback templates until owner/customer evidence exists.

overlaps.conflict_summary: B2R defines domain; E15D defines policy and queues for the same outbound validation space.
overlaps.recommended_resolution: Keep B2R domain as capability definition and E15D as pilot policy implementation after router alignment.

overlaps.conflict_summary: bridge-labs defines a future gov-mcp outbound adapter, but gov-mcp currently exposes governance tools and deterministic execution, not a real outbound provider adapter.
overlaps.recommended_resolution: Do not proceed to real send-gated pilot until gov-mcp owns and tests the outbound adapter interface.

overlaps.conflict_summary: Kill-switch/rate-limit/suppression logic overlaps with earlier suppression and execution gates.
overlaps.recommended_resolution: Make suppression registry and E8 stop conditions canonical guard inputs for E15D outbound safety.

overlaps.conflict_summary: E15D queue derives from E15A owner console to reduce owner manual burden.
overlaps.recommended_resolution: Keep derivation explicit; do not let queue execute until gov-mcp adapter and owner authorization exist.

no_external_side_effects: E16X performs read-only cross-repo inventory and static governance canonicalization only. It performs no customer contact, email/message sending, publication, payment, account creation, form submission, login, external validation submission, customer system access, legal/financial commitment, credential disclosure, core brain/CIEU/memory canonical writeback, real provider API call, outbound adapter call, or real send receipt.
